messages:
maria: Heads up — vendor staging ingest scheduled TOMORROW 14:00 UTC. This is the private VPC bundle (installer + images). Need confirmation on signer rotation plan and rollback criteria.

ethan: I can own signer rotation. Plan: rotate signing key 10m before cutover, push new cosigned manifest to vendor mirror, then trigger canary.

jia: Change window 14:00-16:00 UTC ok for infra. What do we do if vendor-ci rejects signature (mismatch)?

maria: If vendor-ci rejects, we fallback to previously tagged sealed bundle (tag: `v2026.03.01-legacy`) and abort the new deploy. Need to decide abort timeout.

ida: Suggest abort if signer mismatch persists after 15m of attempts. We should also notify customer SREs and flip traffic if canary error rate > 2%.

devop-sam: Quick ops checklist: 
- verify KMS key exists in vendor keyring
- cosign signature uploaded to mirror
- manifest sha256 recorded in release notes
- preflight smoke run in staging 2h before window

maria: Good. Also can we pin installer image digest in the bundle? I want explicit digests not moving tags.

e than: yes — pinning `installer:sha256:0123abcd...` for the release. Release-bot will include digests in notes.

release-bot: Preparing release notes draft: "Private VPC bundle 2026.03.01 — pinned digests for installer & images, signer rotation instructions, rollback to v2026.03.01-legacy if signature validation fails."

devop-sam: deploy-bot command we'll run (dry-run first):
```
/deploy private-bundle --env vendor-staging --tag 2026.03.01 --pin-installer installer:sha256:0123abcd --canary 5% --signer-rotate
```

maria: Dry-run at 12:00 UTC tomorrow. Full run at 14:00. If any manual signer intervention required, ethan will call it and we pause.

deploy-bot: scheduled: /deploy private-bundle to vendor-staging at 2026-03-01T14:00:00Z (canary 5%). Will post status updates here.

vendor-ci: preflight: signature check OK on mirror? NO -> cosign verification failed: manifest signer mismatch (expected key id: key-eta-17)

ethan: on it, checking keyring now. Trying a resubmit of signed manifest.

vendor-ci: retry: signature verification OK after new upload.

ida: good recovery. Keep to the 15m abort rule if it slips.

maria: If we hit more than 3 signature failures across mirrors, escalate to oncall and pause rollout; plan to revert to legacy tag.

devop-sam: Noted. I'll run canary for 30m after successful deploy, metrics to watch: init latency, auth errors, install success rate. If install success < 98% in canary, we abort and rollback.

release-bot: Release notes published to doc: https://redwood.internal/releases/private-vpc/2026-03-01 — includes pinned digests, KMS key id, rollback steps, and contact list.

maria: final confirm: everyone ok with abort timeout 15m for signer rotation and canary monitor 30m with 98% success threshold?

ethan: yes.

jia: yes.

ida: yes. :thumbsup:

devop-sam: I'll be standing by in the window. 

maria: Thanks all — will post dry-run summary tomorrow 12:30 UTC.

release-bot: deploy-bot will announce start/finish events. Keep this thread for updates.

deploy-bot: event: dry-run completed at 2026-03-01T12:05:00Z — no diffs in manifests, signatures validated.

vendor-ci: smoke: installer package integrity OK on staging node 1/3, node 2/3 failed with transient timeout (retry succeeded)

maria: good, proceed to main window at 14:00 UTC. If anything new shows up, ping #eng-oncall and this thread.
